# Disposable coding fixture rules

- This repository contains synthetic public test data only.
- Work only inside the current task worktree.
- Read applicable nested `AGENTS.md` files before changing scoped files.
- Make the smallest change that satisfies the task and run only relevant checks.
- Do not commit unless the task policy explicitly authorizes one local commit.
- Never push, deploy, access credentials, or contact a network service.
- Preserve exact-byte requirements, including the absence of a trailing newline.
